blamers.defect: Typing the enclosing type from the qualifier gives a spurious nullability mismatch for inner classes inheriting enclosing type arguments.

culprit_title: JSpecify: preserve all dimensions of multi-dimensional array creation expressions

blamers.title: Apply covariant array subtyping at every dimension
blamers.defect: Rank mismatch in the computed creation expression type made array nullability comparison bail out, missing an innermost element error.

culprit_title: Preserve nested nullness in enhanced for var types

blamers.title: JSpecify: iterating over a optionally nullable iterable
blamers.defect: Enhanced-for nullness change regressed checking of optionally nullable iterables in 0.14.1, per the reporter.

culprit_title: Track nullable elements in enhanced for dataflow

blamers.title: JSpecify: iterating over a optionally nullable iterable
blamers.defect: Enhanced-for dataflow tracking of nullable elements caused the 0.14.1 regression for optionally nullable iterables, per the reporter.

blamers.title: Model the JSpecify NO_CHANGE nullness operator for wildcard and enhanced-for reads
blamers.defect: Enhanced-for elements of type T are reported as nullable since this change, giving spurious errors on vavr code.

culprit_title: Inherit null-implies-null models across overrides

blamers.defect: Inherited null-implies-null models ignore explicit @Nullable return annotations on overrides, dropping a dereference error.

blamers.title: IllegalStateException "Library models give conflicting nullability" on a PolyNull-modeled parameter when JSpecifyExperimental is off
blamers.defect: PolyNull library models give conflicting nullability and an IllegalStateException when JSpecifyExperimental is off.

culprit_title: Preserve non-null type variables through wildcard capture

blamers.title: Keep the formal type variable when copying a wildcard type
blamers.defect: Wildcard copies dropped the bound field, and the new restoration path from this change then produced wrong super-wildcard bounds.

culprit_title: Avoid stale wildcard bounds after javac supertype inspection

blamers.defect: The NPE on values read through a super wildcard remains without HandleWildcardGenerics, since the fix applies only when that flag is set.

culprit_title: Preserve nullability of intersection bounds

culprit_title: Check nested nullness of explicitly typed lambda parameters
